text.p: Top 10 films showing at Dutch cinemas (pvs week in brackets)
1 (1) INDEPENDENCE DAY - U.S. counters alien invasion in
sensational feast of special effects.
2 (2) THE NUTTY PROFESSOR - Comedy starring Eddie Murphy.
3 (-) CHAIN REACTION - Action/Adventure starring Keanu Reeves.
4 (3) TWISTER - Jan de Bont's disaster film starring Helen Hunt
and Bill Paxton.
5 (4) TIN CUP - Romantic Golf story starring heart-throb Kevin
Costner
6 (5) A TIME TO KILL - Big screen adaptation of John Grisham's
racially charged legal thriller.
7 (7) TRAIN SPOTTING - Controversial junkie film by Danny Boyle
8 (6) LAST MAN STANDING - Highly stylised gangster film
starring Bruce Willis
9 (8) FARGO - Black comedy, winner Golden Palm best director.
10 (-) BREAKING THE WAVES - Highly acclaimed Danish film.
Source: Nederlandse Federatie voor Cinematografie
Following is a selection of films PREMIERING this week:
ESCAPE FROM L.A. - Kurt Russel is back as Snake Plissken in this
follow-up to Escape from New York.
THE FAN - Baseball fanatic turns killer. Starring De Niro.
LE HUITIEME JOUR - Belgian film explores the relationship
between a flipped-out businessman and a Mongoloid youngster.
